name: U-BROS-25
description:
## Description

"A tweeter system that combines a power amplifier and an electronic crossover network in addition to a dedicated tweeter.The electronic crossover network is a two stage CR-type filter with a good connection between the low-frequency and high-frequency sides.Since the signal output on the low frequency side is high impedance, a cathode follower feed amplifier using a vacuum tube is installed to prevent external noise including hum components from entering.All the amplifiers are vacuum tube type, and all the vacuum tubes used are select tubes manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes.The 6L6GC power tube is made by GE Corporation of the United States, and the 6189driver tube (highly reliable 12AU7/ECC82tube) is supplied to the United States Army.The first stage of the power amplifier section is ECC83/12AX7, and the driver and phase inverter stage is a 6189type cathode coupling type. By directly coupling the first stage with the driver and phase inverter stage, the time constant in the low frequency range is eliminated and excellent low frequency transient characteristics are obtained.The power stage is a 6L6GC self-bias system ultra linear connection push-pull system designed to provide stable operation over a long period of time.The tweeter section of the U Ï‰ BROS-25has an impedance of 8�. However, considering the case where the U Ï‰ BROS-25is set to the full range and a full-range speaker is connected, the output matching impedance is set to 4� and 16� in addition to 8�.As with other Uesugi amplifiers, we use transformers jointly developed with tamura Manufacturing.The output transformer is designed with excellent phase characteristics, and the negative feed back is connected to the cathode of the first stage from the exclusive winding, so the operation is stable.The power transformer is completely sealed with a short ring and a ham proof belt to prevent leakage flux.As for the chassis, after bending a 1.6mm thick high-grade steel plate, solder is poured into all the welded parts and polished to create the rounded corners of the four corners.The bonnet cover is also treated in the same way.In consideration of the unique noise generated when a printed circuit board is used, no printed circuit board is used for the wiring, and the wiring is done manually by veteran craftsmen.The tweeter section is equipped with a 3cm soft dome type tweeter made by Dinavio.This unit has excellent directional characteristics, similar response curves for on-axis 0¥, 30¥, and 60� characteristics, excellent distortion factor characteristics, and wide range.Although a cabinet is not required for operation, it is contained in a special cabinet for stable setting. This cabinet is designed for high mechanical strength and uses solid walnut as a surface treatment material.The front net can be attached and removed, but tuning is done with net.To connect the U Ï‰ BROS-25, first connect the output signal from the preamplifier to the input of the amplifier section of the U Ï‰ BROS-25using a pin cord, and then connect the low-frequency output signal of the U Ï‰ BROS-25to the input of the power amplifier using a pin cord and to the main speaker.The tweeter section of the U Ï‰ BROS-25is connected to the 8� output terminal of the amplifier section with a speaker cable.The amplifier section of the U Ï‰ BROS-25is equipped with a frequency range selector. In normal use, the high position provides a low-cut output signal.When this position is set to the full position, it outputs the whole band like a general power amplifier, so if you connect the tweeter section of the U Ï‰ BROS-25, it will be damaged.If you are using a power amp, set the level control to the maximum value, and adjust the volume with the U Ï‰ BROS-25level control.If the high range is insufficient even if the U Ï‰ BROS-25level control is set to the maximum value, set the U Ï‰ BROS-25level control to the maximum value and adjust the power amp level control."

name: U-BROS-17
description:
## Description

"As a successor to the U Ï‰ BROS-11, this monaural power amplifier has been further refined to enhance its perfection.The first stage consists of parallel connection of ECC83/12AX7, the first stage and driver / phase inversion stage are cathode connection type, the balls used are ECC82/12AU7, and the power stage consists of EL34/6CA73-pole tube connection parallel push-pull.In U Ï‰ BORS-11, the first stage tube was connected in parallel with ECC82/12AU7. In U Ï‰ BROS-17, this tube is connected in parallel with ECC83/12AX7and the amount of NFB is set at 14dB. This improves the total SN ratio and stability.The vacuum tubes used in the push-pull circuit are carefully selected matched pair tubes with the same current value after being sufficiently aged by an aging machine specially made by Uesugi Research Institute. This eliminates the DC balance circuit.In addition, the output transformer is designed so that the primary inductance is almost constant so that there is no problem in the characteristics even if there is variation in a set of two vacuum tubes constituting the push-pull.The power supply section uses a choke coil with large inductance to obtain clean DC output and DC current, and the DC resistance of the power transformer and choke coil is reduced as much as possible to keep the supply voltage constant at all outputs.Two parallel inputs are provided, and bi-amp drive system is also available.Transformers developed jointly by Uesugi R &ΩD Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. are used for these transformers. The terminal and casing of these transformers are designed with high reliability equivalent to the specifications for space satellites.Vacuum tubes were manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes, and after being sufficiently aged by a special aging machine, they are carefully selected and used.Wiring is divided into each block such as power supply lock, bias block, and amplification stage block.Since the level controller is located immediately near the first stage tube, no shield wire is used for the wiring to the level controller, and the distance is the shortest, there is no sound quality change by adjusting the level controller.The wiring is hand-made by skilled craftsmen.The chassis is a hand-made finish with rounded corners by bending a 1.6mm thick high-grade iron material and then applying solder to all the welded parts and polishing.In addition, the entire body is finished in metallic and phase to harmonize with the hammer tone transformer case.In the U Ï‰ BROS-11, the catalog display power was 30W, but in the U Ï‰ BROS-17, even with the same EL34/6CA7, it uses the EL34/6CA7made by GE Corporation of America, which has a higher margin, so a large output of 40W is achieved.The four parallel push-pull power tubes are arranged asymmetrically on the positive-phase side and the negative-phase side with respect to the output transformer arrangement in order to eliminate the disadvantage of ""the parallel push-pull is slightly blurred."""

description:
## Description

"This monaural power amplifier was developed as a continuing product in response to the popularity of the limited 300B amplifier UTY-10.The basic configuration is the same as that of the UTY-10, the chassis is slightly larger to provide more space for parts layout, and the 300B filament rectifying circuit and high-voltage rectifying circuit in the power supply section are enhanced.The circuitry consists of an ECC83top stage, an ECC83P-K split phase inverter stage, an ECC82push-pull driver stage, and a 300B self-bias push-pull power stage.The ECC83direct-coupled circuit achieves stable operation by supplying a sufficient bleeder current to stabilize the power supply.The power supply section is bridge rectifier using a high-reliability diode. Since the power tube is 300B, a direct-heating 3-pole output tube, an indirectly heating 2-pole tube called 5AR4/GZ34is used for the power supply system to prevent high voltage from being generated immediately after the switch is turned on.The Golden Dragon / 300B adopted in the output tube basically uses GD300B Super.In U Ï‰ BROS-21, this GD300B Super is aged in an aging machine made by Uesugi Research Institute, and only carefully selected products are used after sorting through performance tests.For the ECC83and ECC82MT tubes, we use highly reliable national-brand tubes that were specially ordered from the K. K. Electron Tube Division of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. in the latter half of the 1965s based on the specifications of Uesugi Research Laboratories.For the 5AR4/GZ34parathermal bipolar tube, we have selected highly reliable tubes made in Russia and manufactured for military use.The transformer uses high-quality products jointly developed by Uesugi R &ΩD Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd., and the terminal and casing of the transformer are designed for high reliability equivalent to strict standards for space satellites.The output transformer has a primary winding to load the power tube, a secondary winding to connect to the speaker system, and an NFB tertiary winding for the main loop.Wiring is used for each block such as power supply block, bias block, and amplification stage block.In addition, the level controller is placed close to the first stage tube, and no shield wire is used for the wiring to the level controller and the shortest wiring is used. Therefore, the sound quality does not change due to the adjustment of the level controller.The wiring work is hand-made by skilled craftsmen.The U Ï‰ BROS-21is designed to be compact and compact without pushing too much.The output transformer is located on the left side of the front, and the power transformer is located on the right side. Two large 300B tubes are placed in the center, and three vacuum tubes, ECC82/12AU7, ECC83/12AX7and 5AR4/GZ34, are placed in the rear.The rear large cover contains three large capacitors, a choke coil, and a 300B filament rectifying circuit. The cover contains a 4-mm-thick aluminum plate that dumps the resonance from the inside, determined by a thorough hearing test."

## Description

"As a successor to the U Ï‰ BROS-15, this is a monaural power amplifier that achieves both high quality and high power.The U Ï‰ BROS-23uses an output transformer, which was jointly developed by Uesugi R &ΩD Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. over a period of three years, thereby achieving both high quality and high power.This output transformer has a primary winding to load the power tube, a secondary winding to connect to the speaker system, an NFB tertiary winding for the main loop, and a cathode feedback fourth winding for the power tube.The power tube uses EL34/6CA7of GE Inc. of the United States, which has a large maximum rating. By operating this in parallel push-pull operation, approximately twice the theoretical power is obtained. The cathode feedback is applied to the cathode of the power tube from the fourth winding dedicated to the cathode feedback of the output transformer, so that both high power and high quality are achieved.The EL34/6CA7can take out high power by operating at a high voltage of around 800v without using parallel push-pull operation. However, in consideration of safety and stability, the EL34/6CA7uses parallel push-pull operation.The phase inverter and driver consists of a cathode composite type with ECC82/12AU7with stable characteristics, and the power stage consists of parallel push-pull and cathode negative feedback connection of EL34/6CA7.In addition, the ECC83/12AX7is designed to reduce the device design by supplying sufficient bleeder current so that the performance will not be disturbed or operation will not become unstable due to the dispersion of the ECC83/12AX7.We use vacuum tubes manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes. These vacuum tubes are sufficiently aged by an aging machine specially made by Uesugi Research Institute, and then carefully selected and used.The chassis has a unique hand-made finish with a 1.6mm thick high-grade iron material that is bent and then solder is poured into all the welded parts and polished to create R at the four corners.Wiring is used for each block such as power supply lock / bias block / amplification stage block.In addition, the level controller is placed close to the first stage tube, and no shield wire is used for the wiring from the level controller, and the shortest wiring is used. This reduces the change in sound quality caused by the adjustment of the level controller.It is hand-made by skilled craftsmen using the UESUGI method of wiring."

name: U-BROS-24
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo power amplifier with low cost by adopting a stereo configuration.In order to reduce the cost without lowering the quality of the parts, it is basically a parallel push-pull of U Ï‰ BROS-23and a stereo version.The power stage uses the EL34/6CA7manufactured by Siemens in the West German era. The EL34/6CA7is operated in a push-pull operation, and NFB is uniformly and stably supplied from the dedicated winding of the output transformer to each cathode. Thus, the excellent quality of the 3-pole tube and the high power characteristics of the multi-pole tube are compatible.The first stage uses ECC83/12AX7/7025A with excellent SN ratio under low load, and the phase inversion stage is a cathode coupled type with ECC82/12AU7.12dB of NFB is applied to the cathode of the first stage from the NFB-dedicated winding of the output transformer. This feedback amount is determined to be the best match with each speaker system by loading the horn type or dome type.Although the circuit configuration has been completely simplified, phase correction is still required because there are two time constants in the low frequency range and three time constants in the high frequency range. high-frequency range. The U Ï‰ BROS-24uses an output transformer that can ensure a large primary inductance in the low-frequency range and minimizes fluctuations in the primary inductance. It also improves the phase characteristics of the output transformer to the utmost and uses a unique differential and integral type phase correction circuit to achieve extremely stable NFB application over the whole round fractional band.The U Ï‰ BROS-24vacuum tubes are carefully selected matched pair tubes with the same current value after being sufficiently aged with an aging machine specially made by Uesugi Research Institute. In addition, the output transformer is designed so that the primary inductance is almost constant, even if there is a variation in characteristics of the pair of two vacuum tubes constituting the push-pull.This eliminates the DC balance circuit.The power supply part is designed with an extremely high margin, and heat generation from the power transformer is kept low for practical use.The power supply circuit uses a large-capacity power transformer and a choke coil instead of a constant current circuit. The capacity of the capacitor is determined by hearing test and stability based on pulse waveform.4¥, 8¥, and 16� Route 3outputs are provided.In addition, since the optimum load curve is designed to be very broad, even if an 8� speaker system is connected to the 4� output terminal of the amplifier, there is no particular mis-matching.High-quality transformers developed jointly by Uesugi Research Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. are used.The output transformer has a primary winding to load the power tube, a secondary winding to connect to the speaker system, an NFB tertiary winding for the main loop, and a cathode feed back fourth winding for the power tube.Wiring is used for each block such as power supply block, bias block, and amplification stage block.In addition, the level controller is placed close to the first stage tube, and no shield wire is used for the wiring to the level controller, and the shortest wiring is used. Thus, the sound quality degradation caused by the level controller adjustment is suppressed.The wiring is hand-made by skilled craftsmen.The chassis has a unique hand-made finish in which high grade iron material of 1.6mm thickness is bent and processed, then solder is poured into all the welded parts and polished to create R at the 4corners.All vacuum tubes were manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes.The front of the chassis is equipped with two input selectors, a level controller for left and right linkage, and a power switch."

name: U-BROS-32
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo power amplifier developed as a successor to U Ï‰ BROS-27.The power tube uses EL34/6CA7made by GE Corporation in the US, which was manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes. This is operated as an ultra-linear connection and NFB is applied in overall.The first stage tube and driver tube are made of 6189W (ECC82/12AU7high-reliability tube) with low internal resistance to obtain excellent high-frequency characteristics, and have a 3-stage configuration. In addition, the first stage tube and driver tube are connected directly and the time constant in the low-frequency range is set to two stages to improve stability in the low-frequency range.In the overall system, the NFB is returned from the third winding of the dedicated winding to the cathode of the first stage tube to maintain stability.Transformers developed jointly by Uesugi Research Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. are used.Both GE/EL34and Philips ECG/6189W vacuum tubes were manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes. These tubes are aged in an aging machine made by Uesugi Research Institute and carefully selected for use.The chassis has a unique hand-made finish with a 1.6mm thick SECC (bonderized steel plate) that is bent and processed, then solder is poured into all the welds and polished to create four rounded corners.The level controller is located close to the first stage tube, so that no shield wire is used for the wiring from the level controller and the shortest wiring is used, thereby suppressing the change in the high-frequency characteristics due to the adjustment of the level controller.UESUGI method of wiring is adopted, and the wiring is hand-made by skilled craftsmen.The single system has the disadvantage that it is difficult to keep the inductance of the primary coil high because direct current flows in the primary coil of the output transformer, and as a result, it is difficult to obtain a large scale bass.The U Ï‰ BROS-32compensates for the disadvantages of a single amplifier by increasing the core volume and increasing the inductance of the primary coil."

name: Specifications
description:
## Description

"This tube type power amplifier kit was released to commemorate the launch of ""Tube Kingdom"" by Stereo Sound Company.Based on the concept of ""Let as many people as possible enjoy the goodness of vacuum tube type amplifier,"" the development design is orthodox, and high performance, high stability and high reliability are compatible.In order to be able to use it by directly connecting a CD player, a level set volume is provided independently on the left and right sides for the input.A 0.47Ï‰ F capacitor is installed at the output of the 100k � vari-ohm. This capacitor stops the inflow of the grid current of the vacuum tube and prevents the generation of garry noise each time the level is adjusted.The top stage vacuum tube uses ECC83/12AX7, which has an excellent signal-to-noise ratio.A current of approximately 0.2mA flows through this top stage, and a current of approximately 10times this value is supplied by the bleeder, so it can operate stably even if it is replaced with another ECC83/12AX7.ECC82/12AU7is used for the phase inverter and driver stage following the top stage. It is directly connected to the top stage to eliminate the time constant in the low frequency range. This method is called the Leak Malard type, and it was also used in the Marantz and Macintosh in the past.In this driver stage, the supply voltage is set to 320v based on the relationship between the supply voltage and the life of the vacuum tube, and the balance between the clipping waveform at maximum output.The driver stage and power stage are CR-coupled for stability, and the power stage is the first self-bias type of push-pull amplifier at Uesugi Research Laboratories.It is said that this is because they wanted to avoid critical adjustment because it is a kit, and they considered the merit that the bias value becomes deep and self-defensive instinct works when a runaway large current flows in the power tube due to some kind of trouble.An enamel type resistor is used for this bias resistor, and by making it larger than necessary at 30W, extremely stable operation is realized.The power stage uses 6L6WGC, which has the highest rating among the 6L6series, the origin of the beam tube, and operates as an ultra-linear connection.The matching impedance of the output terminal is designed as 6-ohm only, and this impedance value can be used for 4- to 8-ohm speakers to improve cost performance.An overall negative feed back of approximately 13dB is applied with high stability from the output terminal of the output transformer to the cathode of the top stage to improve various characteristics as a power amplifier for driving the speaker system.The power supply circuit uses a choke coil with sufficient inductance as a push-pull amplifier because it not only reduces the residual noise level, but also eliminates harmonic components from the residual noise waveform and effectively eliminates noise / hum even when combined with a high-efficiency speaker system.In addition, the high-voltage rectification is bridged by a diode with excellent stability and reliability, and noise countermeasures for the diode are made perfect by isolating the diode itself in a corner of the chassis.Transformers developed jointly by Uesugi Research Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. are used.The output transformer of the U Ï‰ BROS-1/K is designed to ensure a sufficient core volume to obtain good low-frequency characteristics, and to minimize the fluctuation of primary inductance even if the DC balance of the power tube is lost, to obtain stable low-frequency characteristics as an NF amplifier. It also has features such as smooth high-frequency phase characteristics.
